Rock & Roll Hall of Fame on Instagram: "That time Miley turned "Hey Ya!" into a ballad.

@mileycyrus quietly slipped an emotional "Hey Ya!" cover into her 2014 Bangerz Tour set — flipping @outkast’s party anthem into a raw, intimate ballad.

The original, released on Outkast’s Speakerboxxx/The Love Below in 2003, was already a genre-breaking classic. Miley’s version gave it a whole new kind of heart.

Iconic songs like this are why Outkast is a Rock Hall Inductee this year. Watch the 2025 Induction Ceremony on November 8, live on @disneyplus.

How do you feel about Miley's stripped-down version? 👇"
